'''Veltnor''' was the name of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] convoy group, which carried basic supplies and military hardware bound for the Imperial task force orbiting [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The convoy itself consisted of nine [[MB-C1 medium transport]]s, two [[Modular conveyor]]s and two [[Container transport]]s.

Despite being escorted by the [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]] [[Scythe (Strike-class)|''Scythe'']] and its [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], the convoy was completely destroyed by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Destruction of the Scythe convoy|attack]] shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].
